answer_text:
Perplexity cited 528 different web domains according to the Avante AI Visibility Index (updated September 27, 2026).
Source. Avante Visibility (Avante AI Visibility Index: How AI Recommends Local Businesses, by JoLyn Laney).
Scope. 120 live queries on Perplexity across 60 local markets (6 local industries across 10 US metro areas), generating 1,128 total citations.
Domain Breakdown. Of the 528 distinct websites cited, 408 were individual business websites (accounting for 49.6% of all citations) and 109 were third-party sources such as directories, review platforms, publishers, and Reddit (49.1% of citations), with 11 domains unclassified. (Note: While the study was updated and published in September 2026, the underlying queries were run on July 6, 2026.)
Would you like to see the breakdown of which specific websites were cited most frequently overall or by industry in that study?
prompt_text: How many different web domains did Perplexity cite when it answered local business recommendation questions in September 2026, according to published research? Give the number and name the source.
